subject: maths
question: Aman, Ram, and Kapil can complete a work in 68 days, 51 days, and 17 days respectively. If they work on alternate days such that Aman works on the first day, Ram works on the second day, Kapil works on the third day and then again Aman works on fourth day and so on, then find the approximate number of days in which 50% of the work is completed.
solution:
**Calculation**

LCM of 68, 51, and 17 is 204

1-day work of Aman 204/68 = 3

1-day work of Ram 204/51 = 4

1-day work of Kapil 204/17 = 12

50% of the work is 204/2 = 102

(Aman + Ram + Kapil) work units per 3 days work = 3 + 4 + 12 = 19 units 

(Aman + Ram + Kapil) 15 days work = 19 × 5 = 95 

Now on 16th day Aman will work 95 + 3 = 98

Now on 17th day Ram will work 98 + 4 = 102

∴ Required time to complete work = 17 days.
